semantics.structural_owner_tf: same as source_tf unless a separate merge/family rule is explicitly confirmed
semantics.display_tf: source structure is displayed on its own chart and one higher-timeframe chart
plan_b_examples: H4 structure -> H4 chart + D1 chart
H1 structure -> H1 chart + H4 chart
M15 structure -> M15 chart + H1 chart

m15_policy.reason: User explicitly clarified Plan B: M15 structure is used on both M15 and H1.

important: PLAN B direction is source -> self + one higher chart. Do not invert it.
H4 structure must be visible on H4 and D1; H1 structure on H1 and H4; M15 structure on M15 and H1.
Source family is selected once on its own timeframe from CURRENT structures only, then copied with identical geometry to every display timeframe.
Audit preview clears ALL MT4 chart objects on the current chart before drawing only NVT9_TFMAP__ objects.
This is a display mapping only; structural ownership does not change.
No trade authority writeback is allowed.

h1_h4_merge_policy.reason: When turns/adjustments/ranges are broad, H1 and H4 may represent one structural family instead of two separable structures.

visibility_policy.objective: For the current audit preview, show only the nearest family from each source TF assigned by Plan B. Do not add far context automatically.
visibility_policy.current_price_metric: Project TL/CH to the latest closed bar of the display timeframe. Distance is zero when price lies inside the channel; otherwise use distance to the nearest channel boundary.
visibility_policy.note: Current audit preview shows only the nearest family from each Plan-B source TF. Far context is disabled for now. It may be reintroduced only after visual confirmation that direction is otherwise hard to read.

preview_isolation.note: Objects created by indicators are chart objects and may also be removed.
